description: This file contains a suite of tests for Git hook behaviors, including pre-commit and pre-merge-commit hooks, handling of success and failure scenarios, non-executable hooks, and hooks with specific environment requirements.

methods.name: setup_success_hook
methods.description: Sets up a successful hook script with specified content and records expected output.

methods.name: setup_failing_hook
methods.description: Sets up a hook script that fails (exits with a non-zero status) with specified content.

methods.name: setup_non_exec_hook
methods.description: Sets up a hook script that is non-executable and tests handling of non-executable hooks.

methods.name: setup_require_prefix_hook
methods.description: Sets up a hook that requires GIT_PREFIX to have a specific value and verifies behavior accordingly.

methods.name: setup_require_author_hook
methods.description: Sets up a hook that checks author information in environment variables and command line.
